name: GP Industria & Artigianato

intermediate.name: 8th passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 8th passage of the finish line (178.7 km)

story: A nine-rider breakaway built an advantage of over five minutes, but gradually fell apart over the repeated climbs around Larciano. After the final escapees were caught, another group briefly went clear before being reeled in on the last climb. Tom Pidcock then launched his attack on the Mungherino and crested alone before holding his advantage on the descent to Larciano. He won by 12 seconds, with Christian Scaroni beating Anthon Charmig in the chase-group sprint.
